metaTitle: Custom Direct to Garment Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to garment shirts for vibrant, full-color designs. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing and fast turnaround.
introHtml: Direct to garment printing allows you to reproduce full-color logos, photos, and intricate artwork directly onto fabric with exceptional detail. Unlike screen printing, DTG has no setup fees and is ideal for smaller quantities or designs with many colors. This method works best on 100% cotton shirts, giving your company apparel a soft hand feel and vibrant, breathable prints that hold up wash after wash.
heroAltText: Custom direct to garment shirts featuring a full-color company logo printed on a cotton t-shirt
